            terms=[(U[('x',4,t,k)],-6.0) for t in [q]+NB[q]]+[(U[('b',4,q)],-10.0)]
            terms+=[(U[('b',4,t)],1.0) for t in NB[q]]

        U[('n5',6,q)]=net.unit(6,('n5',q),terms,1.0+1.0)"""
